title: METAVERSE RACING KART
description: A high-performance stylized vehicle system scripted in Luau for a massive multiplayer Roblox racing experience.
body:
### Challenge
Developing a physics-based drifting mechanic within Roblox's engine that felt arcade-like but didn't suffer from server latency during 64-player races.

### Solution
We decoupled the vehicle physics from the server, running predictive client-side motion while smoothly interpolating position data to prevent rubber-banding.

### Results
- 64 Player Support
- Client-Side Prediction
- 0.5s Latency Handling

### Technologies Used
- Roblox Studio
- Luau
- Maya

### Client
Pixel Drift Studios
